spindle.console.ResetRefusal.title: ResetRefusal
spindle.console.ResetRefusal.description: A refused reset. `400`: the body is not JSON, the run loads no world, the world does not validate, or the body broke off; nothing changed. `413`: the body is over 1 MiB (1 048 576 bytes), announced or sent; nothing changed. `405` (with `Allow: POST`), `408` (the body did not arrive in time), `411` (a body sent with `Transfer-Encoding`) and `503` (the listener is stopping): answered before the reset runs; nothing changed. `401`, `403` and `404`: on `play --component`, which serves no reset; nothing changed. `500`: a store could not be emptied or a row could not be written; the components emptied before it stay empty, the rows before it stay written, and the decisions and mint of the last world are kept. Source: `crates/spindle-ingress/src/console.rs:112-138`, `crates/spindle-ingress/src/answer.rs:27-32`, `crates/spindle-ingress/src/router.rs:16,136-141,156-158,194-203`, `crates/spindle-ingress/src/listener.rs:206-211,386-430,451-460`, `crates/spindle-host/src/host.rs:864-869,886-889`.
